During the [[time]] of the [[Clone Wars]], a '''Rhydonium mining installation''' was in use in the [[city]] of [[Pons Ora]] on the outback [[planet]] [[Abafar]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[mine]]d the valuable and explosive [[fuel]] [[Rhydonium]] there. The fuel was used in a plan to stock a stolen Republic ship and send it to the [[Republic strategy conference]].<ref name="MIA" /> The [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[D-Squad]] had [[D-Squad's Maxillipede shuttle|their]] [[Maxillipede shuttle|ship]] crash-land on Abafar,<ref name="Sunny Day">{{TCW|A Sunny Day in the Void}}</ref> and later, with the help of a [[clone commando]] named [[Gregor]], who suffered from [[amnesia]], they [[Escape from Abafar|managed]] to steal [[D-Squad's shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttle]], and return the [[encryption module]] to [[Coruscant]], which they got from [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module|their previous mission]].<ref name="SW">{{TCW|Secret Weapons}}</ref> Gregor stayed behind to cover their escape, and the fuel went off, heavily damaging the facility.<ref name="MIA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rhydonium mining installation first appeared in "[[Missing in Action]]," an episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' that first aired on [[January 4]], [[2013]].<ref name="Explore: A Sunny Day in the Void">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep511|text="A Sunny Day in the Void" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
